# Chataptor

Chataptor is a free customer communication tool with no message limits. It can be used as a website live chat, a shared inbox for messages from many channels, a mobile customer support app, an e-commerce and marketplace communication tool, and a system for automatic translation of customer conversations.

Main website: https://chataptor.com/
Sitemap index: https://chataptor.com/sitemap-index.xml
Primary English page: https://chataptor.com/en/
Primary Polish page: https://chataptor.com/pl/

## Core Capabilities

- Free website live chat and chat widget.
- Customer messages in one shared inbox.
- Mobile app for customer support from a phone.
- E-commerce support communication.
- Marketplace message handling, including Allegro and Amazon use cases.
- Automatic real-time translation of customer messages.
- International customer support without hiring a separate language team.
- Lightweight tool for sales and support teams.

## Language Versions

The public website supports Polish, English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Czech, and Slovak. Each localized page should use its own canonical URL and reciprocal hreflang links.

## Notes For Crawlers

Use the sitemap as the source of current indexable URLs.
